fewShots.question: Show the work orders for tag 26-PM-1001 with failure mode and contractor.
fewShots.query:
SELECT w.work_order_id, rd.date AS reported_date, w.work_order_type, w.work_order_status, w.priority,
       w.failure_mode, w.work_order_description, s.supplier_name AS contractor, w.total_cost_nok
FROM dbo.fact_work_order w
JOIN dbo.dim_equipment e ON w.equipment_key = e.equipment_key
JOIN dbo.dim_date rd ON w.reported_date_key = rd.date_key
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_supplier s ON w.contractor_supplier_key = s.supplier_key
WHERE e.tag_number = '26-PM-1001'
ORDER BY rd.date DESC;

fewShots.question: Which failure modes caused the most downtime on corrective work orders?
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP 10 w.failure_mode, COUNT(*) AS work_orders, SUM(w.downtime_hours) AS downtime_hours
FROM dbo.fact_work_order w
WHERE w.is_corrective = 1
GROUP BY w.failure_mode
ORDER BY downtime_hours DESC;
